papers.title: Defect closure behavior and microstructural evolution of Ti-6Al-4V alloy fabricated by electron beam wire-feed additive manufacturing during hot compression and hot isostatic pressing
papers.first_author_affiliation: School of Materials and Chemistry, University of Shanghai for Science and Technology, Shanghai 200093, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Yi Yang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Materials and Chemistry, University of Shanghai for Science and Technology, Shanghai 200093, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文聚焦Ti-6Al-4V合金在热等静压和热压缩过程中的缺陷闭合与显微组织演变，直接对应后处理对疲劳/力学性能的影响方向。
llm.why_not_core: The paper primarily investigates defect closure mechanisms and microstructural evolution during hot compression and HIP, but does not directly report fatigue or tensile mechanical property results after post-processing.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究热压缩和热等静压对增材制造Ti-6Al-4V缺陷闭合及显微组织的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用电子束丝材增材制造制备试样，随后进行热压缩和热等静压处理
summary_zh.result: 揭示了不同工艺参数下缺陷闭合行为与显微组织演变规律
summary_zh.validation: 通过微观组织观察和力学测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the defect closure behavior and microstructural evolution of electron beam wire-feed additive manufactured Ti-6Al-4V during hot compression and hot isostatic pressing.
summary_en.method: Specimens were fabricated by electron beam wire-feed additive manufacturing and subsequently subjected to hot compression and hot isostatic pressing treatments.
summary_en.result: The study elucidates the mechanisms of defect closure and microstructural changes under different processing conditions.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through microstructural characterization and mechanical testing.

papers.title: Studies on High Temperature Wear Behavior of Additively Manufactured Ti-6Al-4V Alloy Using Machine Learning Models
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, V.S.B. Engineering College, Karur, 639111, India

corresponding_authors.name: D. Amrishraj
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, V.S.B. Engineering College, Karur, 639111, India

papers.venue: Journal of Materials Engineering and Performance

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究增材制造Ti-6Al-4V合金的高温磨损行为，而非方向所要求的力学或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: Paper focuses on wear behavior, not on mechanical/fatigue properties (tensile, fatigue, etc.) as required by the direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究增材制造Ti-6Al-4V合金的高温磨损行为。
summary_zh.method: 使用机器学习模型进行磨损性能预测。
summary_zh.result: 机器学习模型能有效预测磨损性能。
summary_zh.validation: 基于实验数据验证模型准确性。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the high-temperature wear behavior of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V alloy.
summary_en.method: Machine learning models were employed to predict wear properties.
summary_en.result: Machine learning models effectively predicted wear performance.
summary_en.validation: Experimental data were used for model validation.
